1. (Currently Amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus Type lb (BVDV-lb) that is cytopathic, __a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.__

3. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; __or one or more inactivated viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom.__

4. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBR virus, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof; __wherein at least one of the modified, live viruses is present in an immunologically effective amount.__

6. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen, __wherein the first antigen is obtained from an organism that is not BVDV-lb.__

8. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated __or non-live.__

12. (Currently Amended) The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen __distinct from BVDV-lb.__
